_doc: THE LAST LIGHT campaign. Beats run in order; 'when' is a StoryState expression (flag(), has_flag(), clue(), saved(), lost(), piloting(), lit_by_hand(), relation(), sim.*). Actions: talk, wait, objective, set/add/clue, ship, storm, clock, fault, battery, autosave, end_campaign; anything else is a presentation event (title, thought, timeskip, sky, phantom_echo, footsteps, knock, visitor_enter, document, music, sfx, hint_device, credits).

beats.objective: Get your bearings. (WASD to walk · mouse to look)
hint: Move with W A S D. Look around with the mouse.

beats.objective: Lighting-up time. Turn the MODE selector to AUTO at the light console (east wall).
hint: The light console stands under the east window. Look at the MODE knob and press E.

beats.objective: Turn the LAMP selector up to NORMAL.
Check the battery meter on the charger (west wall).
hint: The charger is the grey cabinet on the west wall, left of the windows. Look at the BATTERY meter and press E.

beats.objective: Start the generator: open the FUEL VALVE, then hold START (the cage, south-west).
hint: In the cage: the red FUEL VALVE handle first, then hold E on the black START button until the engine catches.

beats.objective: Switch CHARGE on at the charger.
hint: The CHARGE lever is on the charger cabinet, below the small meter.

beats.objective: Use the radio (desk) and ask Kittiwake to CONFIRM POSITION.
hint: Sit at the radio on the desk (look at it, press E), select Kittiwake and choose 1 · Confirm position.

beats.objective: Turn Kittiwake onto the North Sound leading line (000°) until she reports the channel.
hint: On the radar she sits to the right of the dashed 000° line. Order TURN PORT once or twice, then MAINTAIN when she points down the line.

beats.objective: Watch Kittiwake into the Sound.
Write up the evening in the station log (desk).
hint: The logbook lies open on the desk, left of the chart.

beats.objective: Watch the radar for the caller.
Bring Gannet in through the West Gut (314°).
hint: Confirm Gannet's position, then turn her until she points down the West Gut line on the radar.

beats.objective: Find the 1953 station log in the old-log box (storage shelf, left of the stair door).
hint: The old station logs are in the oak box on the top storage shelf, left of the stair door.

beats.objective: Clear the motor jam: MODE to OFF, then back to AUTO.
hint: MODE knob on the console: right click turns it back. OFF, wait a second, then AUTO.

beats.objective: Bring Corrie May and Lowestoft Star in. Mind the battery.
beats.when: (saved("Corrie May") or lost("Corrie May")) and (saved("Lowestoft Star") or lost("Lowestoft Star"))
hint: Corrie May belongs in the East Gut (046°), Lowestoft Star in the North Sound (000°). Confirm each, then turn them onto the lines.

beats.objective: Restore power: reset the MAIN breaker (distribution cabinet, west wall).
hint: In the dark: the red MAIN lamp on the tall cabinet. Push the MAIN lever up (E).

beats.objective: Identify the dark boat: switch to MANUAL and hold the beam on her with the handwheel.
hint: MODE to MANUAL, then at the console hold A / D on the handwheel until the beam sits on her (the radar shows the beam line).

beats.objective: She will not answer. Watch her come in.
Someone is at the door.
hint: The stair door is on the south wall.

beats.objective: Search the desk drawers.
hint: The bottom-left drawer of the desk.

beats.objective: Get the light back: reset MAIN and keep the generator alive.
hint: MAIN breaker on the west wall. If the generator has cut out hot, let it cool, then restart it.

beats.objective: Hold the light on Iona Star and talk her into the East Gut (046°).
hint: MANUAL mode puts a long beam on her so she can see. Confirm her position, then turn her onto the 046° line.
